caveats: These are annual averages for Colombo, not individual-ship records, maximum delays, terminal-specific performance or service guarantees. Different time measures cannot be substituted for one another or added as a verified identity. Ship size, cargo mix and operating conditions can affect the averages; the table does not establish causes of changes. Tonnage rates are metric tonnes per ship-hour, not container counts or TEU productivity.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One annual Colombo port average, ship type and measure
notes: Sri Lanka Ports Authority annual averages compiled by DCS for 2018–2024. Each measure distinguishes container and non-container ships. Time measures are average waiting, service and turnaround time in hours. Handling rates are metric tonnes per ship-hour at berth and in port.
